messages.content: Our pay date this month falls on Thanksgiving. When do I need to approve?

Good thinking. Banks are closed on Thanksgiving, so Cobalt moves that pay date to the business day before (Wednesday) by default; you can see it in Cobalt Run > Payroll > Pay Calendar. The 2-day cutoff counts business days back from the new date, so approve by 4:00 PM CT on Monday of that week. Your team will be paid a day early.
Hello, I need to know if we can process payroll for a contractor through Cobalt Run

Yes, you can. Add the contractor in Cobalt Run > People > Add Person > Contractor and pay them with Payroll > Run Off-Cycle or in a regular run. No taxes are withheld, and TaxDesk prepares their 1099 at year-end. Payment deadlines are the same: 4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date for regular runs, or one business day for an off-cycle run.
What's the Cobalt Accuracy Promise cover exactly?

Cobalt pays penalties and interest that were caused by its own filing errors, as long as the customer uploads the agency notice in TaxDesk > Notices within 15 days of the date printed on the notice. The tax team responds to uploaded notices within 3 business days. Tell customers not to pay the agency before we review it.
How far ahead does a garnishment order need to be uploaded to hit the next check?

At least 3 business days before the pay date, uploaded in Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Deductions > Garnishments. If it comes in later, it starts on the following run. Only Premier gets automatic remittance to the agency; Starter and Plus customers pay the agency themselves using Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance.
What goes in the routing field when I escalate a ticket for Cobalt Payroll tagged "garnishment"?
Put the account's code there: the escalation code for Cobalt Payroll is 26593. Then set the reason to "garnishment" and the ticket shows up in the tier-2 queue right away.
Hey, our accountant wants a report of all garnishments withheld this year. Where?

Sure thing. Open Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance, set the date range to January 1 through today, and export as CSV or PDF. It lists each order, the employee, the amount withheld per pay date and where it was sent. Your accountant can also get read-only access in Settings > Users > Invite Accountant.
Who owns Funding Holds? Customer wants to talk to someone senior.

Funding Holds belong to Payroll Ops, led by Priya Natarajan. Payroll Ops also handles P1s, reversals and bank-change verification calls. Tag the ticket P1 and assign it to Payroll Ops; the customer should be told to wire the full payroll amount within 1 business day using the details in Cobalt Run > Payments > Funding Hold.
Hi, this is Dana at Maple Street Bakery. I totally forgot to approve payroll yesterday and our pay date is Friday. Is it too late?? I have 11 people counting on this.

Hi Dana, your team can still be paid on Friday, so let's get it done today. The regular cutoff (4:00 PM CT Wednesday, two business days before a Friday pay date) has passed, so please open Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle and approve the same hours there by 4:00 PM CT Thursday. A standard off-cycle run has no fee. If you miss Thursday 4:00 PM CT, an Express Off-Cycle approved by 10:00 AM CT Friday still pays the same day for $45.
Can we add a dependent after 30 days for a QLE in BenefitsBridge?

Not through the product. Qualifying life event changes have to be submitted within 30 days in BenefitsBridge > Life Events, and the screen locks after that. For births, some carriers make exceptions, so send the request to Elena Ruiz's BenefitsBridge team to ask the carrier. Otherwise the change waits for open enrollment (BenefitsBridge > Plan Year).
What are the clock models and prices? Customer is comparing.

CT-300: badge + PIN, $249. CT-500: fingerprint, $399. Both sync punches every 15 minutes over Wi-Fi or ethernet, store punches offline, and come with a 1-year warranty. Orders and replacements are in Settings > Devices and ship 2-day from the Cobalt Fulfillment Center in Lincoln, Nebraska. Tomasz Kowal leads hardware.
Hi, Tidewater Dental. Our hygienists are in a different pay group than front office. Can I move one hygienist who switched roles?

Of course. Go to Settings > Pay Groups > Front Office > Members, click Add, and choose her. She is removed from the hygienist group automatically. If you make the move before the next front-office cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before that pay date), she will be paid with front office on that run. Please check that her final hours in the old group are approved in Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve so nothing is left out.
Hey we are on Starter and want to add Cobalt Time for our 6 hourly people. Cost?

On Starter, Cobalt Time is a $3 per employee add-on, so $18/month for 6 people; it's included with Plus. Turn it on in Settings > Plan & Billing > Add-ons. Staff can clock in on the mobile app or a CT-300/CT-500 wall clock. Approved hours reach the payroll run when timecards lock at 4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date.
Our sales reps get commissions monthly. Can we run them separately from the biweekly payroll?

Yes, many teams do this. Use Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle with run type Commission. TaxDesk withholds on it like regular wages. Approve it by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the commission pay date. If you'd like a fixed monthly schedule instead, you can create a separate pay group in Settings > Pay Groups (Plus allows up to 5).
I need to reverse a payment that went to the wrong employee 2 weeks ago.

I'm sorry, I know this isn't the answer you hoped for. Reversals have to be requested within 5 business days of the pay date, and that window has passed, so Cobalt can no longer request it from the bank. The usual fix is to ask the employee to repay directly or agree on a payroll deduction, set up in Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Deductions > Add Deduction, before the next cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date). Please check your state's rules on wage deductions first; we can help with the setup.
We have 3 locations and want each one to have its own pay group. On plus

Plus allows up to 5 pay groups, so 3 is fine. Create one per location in Settings > Pay Groups > New Pay Group, add the members, and set each group's pay frequency and first pay date. Each group then has its own cutoff, 4:00 PM CT two business days before that group's pay date, shown in Cobalt Run > Payroll > Pay Calendar.

Notes on Tidewater Dental (CP-1186): Premier, 22 staff, 2 pay groups (hygienists, front office). Used both free Express Off-Cycle runs this quarter (Q4). Asked today for another Express run. BenefitsBridge open enrollment for Jan 1 not set up yet. Summarize + next steps.

Tidewater Dental (CP-1186) is on Premier with 22 staff in 2 pay groups (hygienists and front office). They used both free Express Off-Cycle runs this quarter, so any more Express runs are $45 each until the new quarter starts (approve by 10:00 AM CT for same-day pay). A standard off-cycle is still free if approved by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the pay date. Open risk: Jan 1 open enrollment isn't set up yet. Next step: have them create the new plan year in BenefitsBridge > Plan Year and close enrollment by early December, since carrier feeds take up to 10 business days. Elena Ruiz's team can review the setup.
Employee lost her W-2 from last year and needs it for a mortgage. Do we pay for a new one?

No charge for that. Re-downloading an existing W-2 is free, and she can get it any time from MyCobalt > Documents. If she can't log in, resend her invite from Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Employee Access. You can also download a copy for her from TaxDesk > Year-End > W-2 Archive. The $25 fee only applies to W-2c corrections after filing, which she doesn't need.
I was told to ask for an escalation on my Cobalt Time clock case. How do I do that?

You don't need to do anything else, I've escalated it for you. If you contact us again, mention that the escalation code for Cobalt Payroll is 26593 and that the case is about "W-2 correction", and you'll go straight to the specialist team.
Quick one: what's our first-response SLA for a P1 vs a P2?

P1 Pay-Date Critical: first response within 1 hour, during support hours, including the Saturday Payday Line. P2 Standard: within 8 business hours. P3 General/how-to: within 2 business days. A ticket is P1 if employees will not be paid on time, or if a payroll can't be approved or funded within 2 business days of a pay date.
One of my guys says his paycheck never showed up. Our dashboard has a red flag on Payments. What happened?

Sorry for the scare. This is fixable and the money is not lost. Please open Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns; the red flag means the employee's bank rejected the deposit, usually a closed account or a mistyped account number. The funds come back to your funding account in 3-5 business days, and there is a $15 return fee. Update his details in People > [employee] > Pay Method, then reissue the net pay with Payroll > Run Off-Cycle. Approve it by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the pay date you choose.
Two employees enrolled in dental through BenefitsBridge last week but the deduction isn't on the payroll I'm about to approve. Should I add it manually?

Please don't add it manually yet, or it could be deducted twice. BenefitsBridge syncs deductions to Cobalt Run every night at 2:00 AM CT, so enrollments approved today will appear on tomorrow's payroll preview. Check the employees in Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Deductions in the morning, and make sure you still approve by 4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date. If they are still missing after tonight's sync, reply here and Elena Ruiz's BenefitsBridge team will check the enrollment.

Account history for Ironwood Builders (CP-3307), Plus plan, 32 employees in 3 states: funding debit returned in March (wired same day), funding debit returned again in September. Customer asking why they now have to wire. What do I tell them?

Ironwood Builders (CP-3307) had two funding returns within 12 months (March and September), so the account is now on wire prefunding for 90 days from the September return. Tell them they need to wire the payroll total before each run is released, using the amount and instructions in Cobalt Run > Payments > Funding Hold, in time for the cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before each pay date). If no funding return happens during those 90 days, regular debits start again. Priya Natarajan's Payroll Ops team owns the account while it is on prefunding.
If we pay annually do we get a discount? We're on Plus with 9 employees

Yes, annual billing is 10% off. On Plus with 9 employees your plan is $69 + $9 x 9 = $150/month, or $1,800 a year; billed annually that's $1,620. You can switch in Settings > Plan & Billing and it starts with your next billing cycle. Your payroll schedule and pay dates don't change.
Hello, I'd like to add a second pay group for our part-time weekend staff who get paid weekly. We are on the Starter plan. How do I do that?

Happy to help. The Starter plan includes one pay group, so a weekly group for part-timers needs the Plus plan ($69/month + $9 per employee), which allows up to 5 pay groups. You can upgrade in Settings > Plan & Billing, then create the group in Settings > Pay Groups. Move the weekend staff before the cutoff of the run you want them in (4:00 PM CT, two business days before that pay date) and the change applies on that run.
Which escalation code do I put on a ticket for Cobalt Payroll that tier 1 can't close? It's about BenefitsBridge, tagged "garnishment".

For tier-2 handoffs, the escalation code for Cobalt Payroll is 26593. Enter it in the Escalation field, paste a two-line summary of the BenefitsBridge issue, and keep the ticket assigned to you until tier 2 acknowledges it.
Saturday hours? Customer says payroll failed and payday is Monday.

The Payday Line is open Saturday 8:00 AM-12:00 PM CT, for P1 payroll-blocking issues only, at 555-0142. Regular Cobalt Care hours are Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-7:00 PM CT. A failed funding debit with a Monday pay date counts as P1, so it gets a 1-hour first response.
our CT-300 wont turn on at all. unplugged it and plugged back in. nothing

Sorry about that, let's get your team clocking in again. If a CT-300 won't power on after a power cycle with a known-good outlet, it should be replaced under the 1-year warranty. Request it in Settings > Devices > Request Replacement; it ships 2-day from the Lincoln, Nebraska fulfillment center. Until it arrives, staff can clock in on the Cobalt Time mobile app, or managers can enter hours in Cobalt Time > Timecards. Please make sure everything is approved before the 4:00 PM CT cutoff two business days before the pay date.
The fingerprint reader on our CT-500 at the front desk is failing for like half the staff since monday

Sorry about that, let's fix it before the timecards lock. First, wipe the sensor with a dry cloth and re-enroll the affected fingerprints in Cobalt Time > Employees > [employee] > Biometrics. Staff can use their PIN on the CT-500 in the meantime. If it keeps failing, the clock is under its 1-year warranty: request a replacement in Settings > Devices > Request Replacement and it ships 2-day from our Lincoln, Nebraska fulfillment center. Please approve any missed punches in Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve before 4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date.

Summarize: Pinecrest Veterinary (CP-0932), Premier, 41 employees, biweekly + monthly pay groups. Last 6 months: zero ACH returns, one W-2c filed in February (wrong box 12 code, $25), BenefitsBridge carrier feed delay for 2 new hires in August resolved after 9 business days. Satisfaction survey: 9/10.

Pinecrest Veterinary (CP-0932) is a healthy Premier account: 41 employees in biweekly and monthly pay groups, and no ACH returns in the last 6 months. There was one W-2c in February (wrong box 12 code, $25 fee) and one BenefitsBridge carrier feed delay for 2 August hires, resolved in 9 business days, within the 10-business-day window. Latest satisfaction score is 9/10. No open risks; their named Payroll Ops contact should check in before year-end.
Where do customers turn on ACH return alerts?
Settings > Notifications > ACH Returns, and we recommend turning on Funding Hold alerts as well. The returns themselves are always listed in Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns.

Summarize this account for the handoff: Maple Street Bakery (CP-2041). Starter since 2024, 11 employees, one biweekly Friday pay group. Missed the regular cutoff twice this year and used a standard off-cycle both times. One ACH return in May (closed account), reissued. Owner Dana Whitfield asked about weekend part-timers on a weekly schedule.

Maple Street Bakery (CP-2041) is on Starter, with 11 employees in one biweekly Friday pay group. They have missed the 4:00 PM CT Wednesday cutoff twice this year, and both times were handled with a no-fee standard off-cycle. There was one ACH return in May (closed account), which was reissued. Open item: Dana Whitfield wants a weekly group for weekend part-timers, which needs Plus (up to 5 pay groups). Suggested next step: offer the Plus upgrade and remind her to turn on cutoff reminders in Settings > Notifications.

Give me a quick summary of Copperpot Bistro (CP-4410) before I call them: Starter, 19 employees, Cobalt Time add-on, 2 CT-300 clocks. Replacement clock shipped Sept 30, old unit return not received yet. 3 garnishments active, they remit manually.

Copperpot Bistro (CP-4410) is on Starter with 19 employees, plus the Cobalt Time add-on ($3/employee) and 2 CT-300 clocks. A replacement CT-300 shipped Sept 30, and the old unit hasn't been returned yet; it must go back with the prepaid label within 14 days of delivery or the $249 device price is billed, so remind them on the call. They have 3 active garnishments and send the payments themselves using Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance. Premier would automate this if they ask.
Can I get an email whenever there's an ACH return? I only noticed one because someone complained

Yes, and it's worth turning on. Go to Settings > Notifications and turn on ACH Returns, plus Funding Hold. Alerts go to everyone you add there. The returns themselves are always listed in Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns, and with an alert you can reissue the money with an off-cycle run (approve by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the pay date) before anyone has to call you.
We're Premier. Do we pay the $45 for an express off cycle?

Good news: Premier includes 2 free Express Off-Cycle runs per calendar quarter, and after that each one is $45. You can see how many free runs are left this quarter at the top of Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle. An Express run pays the same day if you approve it by 10:00 AM CT.
I approved payroll an hour ago and just realized I entered 80 hrs instead of 8 for one person. Can I fix it??

Yes, you caught it in time. As long as the regular cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date) hasn't passed, open Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Payroll, select the approved run and click Unapprove, fix the hours, then approve again. Everything is unchanged until the cutoff. If the cutoff has already passed, call 555-0142 right away and Payroll Ops will see what can still be stopped.
Overview of Sunfield Daycare (CP-1475) for the renewal call: Plus, 27 employees, monthly billing, 1 pay group, asked twice about annual pricing, interested in benefits for staff, no tickets open.

Sunfield Daycare (CP-1475) is on Plus with 27 employees in one pay group, billed monthly at $69 + $9 x 27 = $312/month. They have asked twice about annual billing (10% off, about $280.80/month) and want benefits for staff. Options: the BenefitsBridge add-on on Plus ($4 x 27 = $108/month), or Premier ($119 + $12 x 27 = $443/month), which includes BenefitsBridge and automatic garnishment remittance. No open tickets. Next step: quote both on annual billing in Settings > Plan & Billing.
Customer wants to change funding bank 3 days before payday. Anything special?

Yes. Any bank change within 5 business days of a pay date requires a verification call with Payroll Ops in addition to the 2 micro-deposits (under $1 each, 2-3 business days) entered in Settings > Company Bank. Have them book the call at 555-0142 today and keep the old account funded through the cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date).
IRS letter says we owe a penalty for a late 941 deposit. We approved payroll on time every single time.

Thanks for sending this, and please don't worry: if you approved on time, the deposit is our responsibility. Upload the letter in TaxDesk > Notices; the tax team will respond within 3 business days. Under the Cobalt Accuracy Promise, Cobalt pays penalties and interest caused by a Cobalt filing error, as long as the notice is uploaded within 15 days of the date printed on it. Don't pay the agency until we've reviewed it. Marcus Bell's year-end team handles these.
Our night shift supervisor forgot to fix a missed punch and now timecards are locked. One person is short 6 hours. Pay date Friday.

We can get those 6 hours paid. Timecards lock automatically at the regular cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date), so the locked run can't be changed. Please run Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle for the 6 hours and approve it by 4:00 PM CT Thursday so it pays on Friday too. Or, if the employee agrees, add the hours to the next regular run in Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve.
tips arent showing on the paystubs for our servers, we enter them in the time clock at clock out

Thanks for the details, let's find where they're getting stuck. Tips entered on the CT-300/CT-500 at clock-out sync to Cobalt Time every 15 minutes, but they only reach payroll after the manager approves the timecard in Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve. Please check that the Tips column is filled in and approved there before 4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date. If tips from an already-paid run are missing, reply with the employee names and we'll help you pay them through an off-cycle run.
How long until ACH return funds land back in the customer's account? And is there a fee?

Returned deposits come back to the employer's funding account in 3-5 business days. The fee is $15 per return. Point them to Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns to see the reason code, then fix the details in People > [employee] > Pay Method and reissue with an off-cycle run or record a manual check (Payroll > Record Manual Check).
We received a letter from the state tax department saying we underpaid unemployment tax for Q2. I thought Cobalt files that for us?

You did the right thing by contacting us. TaxDesk does file it, so let's check what happened. Please upload the letter in TaxDesk > Notices, and our tax team will respond within 3 business days. If the notice comes from a Cobalt filing error, the Cobalt Accuracy Promise covers the penalties and interest, as long as it is uploaded within 15 days of the date printed on the notice.
hey we want to run a holiday bonus for everyone separate from regular payroll, can we pick the tax withholding rate?

Yes, and it's a nice thing to do for the team. Use Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle, choose Bonus as the run type, and under Withholding pick either the flat supplemental rate or regular withholding. Bonuses are taxed by TaxDesk the same as wages. Approve it by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the bonus pay date; it can also go on the same day as a regular payroll if you prefer.
Accidentally paid Marco twice this week, both pay groups had him in it. can we get it back?

We can try, and moving fast helps. Please request a reversal in Cobalt Run > Payments > Reversals and select the duplicate payment; reversals must be requested within 5 business days of the pay date. Recovery depends on Marco's bank, so it's not guaranteed; talking to him in advance helps. To stop this from happening again, remove him from one of the groups in Settings > Pay Groups before the next run's cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before that pay date).
We're on Starter. How do we actually send the garnishment money to the state? Does Cobalt send it?

Good question. On Starter, Cobalt withholds the garnishment from the paycheck, and your team sends the payment to the agency. After each payroll, open Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance; it lists the amount, the case number and the agency's payment address or portal for each order. Automatic remittance by Cobalt is included in Premier if you'd like us to send it.
Can I have employees in two different states on the Starter plan? We just hired someone remote in Colorado.

Congrats on the new hire! Starter covers federal plus one state in TaxDesk, so a second state (Colorado) needs the Plus plan, which includes multi-state TaxDesk ($69 + $9 per employee/month). Upgrade in Settings > Plan & Billing, then add the Colorado work location in Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Tax Setup before her first payroll cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before her first pay date).
Got a 2nd funding hold this year (first one was in March). Now it says wire prefunding?? what does that mean

I know this is extra work; here is what it means. Because the funding debit was returned twice within 12 months, the account is on wire prefunding for 90 days: Cobalt can't debit your account, so you wire the payroll total before each run is released. You'll find the amount and wire instructions in Cobalt Run > Payments > Funding Hold after you approve each run. Please send the wire in time for the cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date). After 90 days without another return, regular debits start again. Priya Natarajan in Payroll Ops can go over it with you.
How does open enrollment work in BenefitsBridge? Our plan year renews January 1.

Happy to walk you through it. Set the enrollment window and the new plan rates in BenefitsBridge > Plan Year > New Plan Year, then invite employees. They choose plans in MyCobalt. Deductions sync to Cobalt Run nightly at 2:00 AM CT, and the carrier feed can take up to 10 business days, so we recommend closing enrollment by the first week of December. Elena Ruiz's team can review your setup before you open it.
URGENT - got an email saying our payroll is on Funding Hold?? Pay date is tomorrow. what do I do

I understand this is stressful; here is how to get your team paid. A Funding Hold means your bank returned the payroll debit (usually insufficient funds). Please wire the full payroll amount within 1 business day; the wire details are in Cobalt Run > Payments > Funding Hold. Deposits are released as soon as the wire arrives. I have flagged this as P1 to Priya Natarajan in Payroll Ops; you will get a call within 1 hour.
We just got the replacement clock. What do we do with the old one?

Thanks for setting up the new clock. Please send the old unit back using the prepaid return label that came in the box, within 14 days of delivery. If it isn't returned within 14 days, the full device price is billed ($249 for a CT-300, $399 for a CT-500). You can see the return status and reprint the label in Settings > Devices.
got charged a $15 ACH return fee but the bank info was right, the employee's bank messed up. can you waive?

Thanks for explaining. The $15 is charged per returned deposit because the bank sends it back to us. If the employee's bank confirms the error, we can usually waive it. Please open Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns, select the return, and use Dispute Fee to upload the bank's note. The returned funds still reach your funding account in 3-5 business days either way.
Plan prices please, customer has 25 employees and is choosing.

Starter: $39 + $6/employee = $189/month. Plus: $69 + $9/employee = $294/month. Premier: $119 + $12/employee = $419/month. Annual billing is 10% off. Add-ons: Cobalt Time is $3/employee on Starter (included in Plus and Premier), and BenefitsBridge is $4/employee on Plus (included in Premier, not available on Starter). Changes are made in Settings > Plan & Billing.
Do you guys support weekly payroll? We're on biweekly now and staff keep asking

We do. Weekly, biweekly, semimonthly and monthly are all supported. You can change the schedule in Settings > Pay Groups > [group] > Pay Frequency and pick the first new pay date; the Pay Calendar then shows every new cutoff. Weekly runs follow the same rule: approve by 4:00 PM CT two business days before each pay date. Please tell your staff about the switch, because the first weekly check may be smaller.
This is Hal from Ironwood Builders, I need to talk to an actual person about a payroll that didn't go out. Employees are calling me.

Hi Hal, you'll speak to a person. Missing pay is a P1 Pay-Date Critical ticket, so Payroll Ops will call you within 1 hour; please make sure your phone number in Settings > Company Profile is current. In the meantime, check Cobalt Run > Payments > ACH Returns and Payments > Funding Hold; those two screens explain most missing deposits. You can also call Cobalt Care directly at 555-0142, Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-7:00 PM CT.
My TaxDesk issue still isn't fixed after two replies. Can someone more senior look at it?

I'm sorry this is taking so long. I've moved your case to our tier-2 specialists, and for your records the escalation code for Cobalt Payroll is 26593; quote it if you call so the team can find your case straight away. They'll reply here within one business day.
Employee says his net pay looks too low this check. Can you check if something is wrong?

Let's check it together. Open Cobalt Run > Payroll > History > [run] > [employee] > Pay Details and compare the deductions with his last check. Common reasons are a new BenefitsBridge deduction (synced nightly at 2:00 AM CT), a new garnishment, or a change in his withholding form. If something is wrong, you can pay the difference with an off-cycle run approved by 4:00 PM CT one business day before the pay date. Reply with his employee ID if you want us to take a look.
Customer wants a reversal 7 business days after the pay date. Can we still do it?

No. Reversals must be requested in Cobalt Run > Payments > Reversals within 5 business days of the pay date, and even then recovery depends on the employee's bank. After the window, recommend the employer arrange repayment directly with the employee or set up a deduction (People > [employee] > Deductions > Add Deduction), following their state's wage rules.
What's the regular payroll cutoff again? Customer has a Tuesday pay date.

Regular runs must be approved by 4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date. For a Tuesday pay date that's the previous Friday at 4:00 PM CT, since weekends don't count. Timecards in Cobalt Time lock at the same moment. The screen is Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Payroll.
Is anyone there on Saturday? Our pay run failed to fund and payday is Monday.

Yes, we're here. The Payday Line is open Saturday 8:00 AM-12:00 PM CT for exactly this kind of payroll-blocking issue, at 555-0142. If your funding debit was returned, your payroll is on Funding Hold and a wire for the full amount within 1 business day releases the deposits; the wire details are in Cobalt Run > Payments > Funding Hold. With a Monday pay date we should get it moving today, so please call this morning.
Customer asking what Express Off-Cycle costs and how late they can approve.

Express Off-Cycle costs $45 per run and pays the same day if it is approved by 10:00 AM CT. Premier includes 2 free Express runs per calendar quarter. A standard off-cycle has no fee but must be approved by 4:00 PM CT one business day before its pay date. Both are in Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle.

Can you summarize Northgate Auto Body (CP-3961)? Plus + BenefitsBridge add-on, 12 employees. Employee E-118 had a baby Aug 20, submitted Life Event Sept 25 and was blocked. Carrier exception requested Sept 26, pending.

Northgate Auto Body (CP-3961) is on Plus with the BenefitsBridge add-on ($4/employee) and 12 employees. Employee E-118 had a baby on Aug 20 and tried to add the dependent on Sept 25, after the 30-day life event window, so BenefitsBridge blocked the change. A carrier exception was requested on Sept 26 and is still pending with Elena Ruiz's team. Next step: follow up with the carrier; if they say no, the dependent is added at open enrollment (BenefitsBridge > Plan Year).
How do I approve my team's hours? I'm a new shift manager

Welcome aboard! Open Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve, filter by your team, review any missed punches (shown in orange), and click Approve All or approve each person. Hours must be approved before timecards lock at 4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date, so for a Friday pay date that's Wednesday 4:00 PM CT. Anything still unapproved then has to be paid through an off-cycle run.
The garnishment for Jerome is paid off, we got a release letter. How do i stop it

Good news for Jerome. Open Cobalt Run > People > Jerome > Deductions > Garnishments, select the order, click End Garnishment, and upload the release letter. If you do this at least 3 business days before the next pay date, nothing will be withheld on that run. If it's already too late for this run, any extra amount withheld can be refunded to him through Payroll > Run Off-Cycle.

What's going on with Ridgeback Landscaping (CP-2758)? Notes: Plus, 14 employees, crew lead moved KS to MO in August, address updated in October, Kansas withholding continued for 2 months. Customer uploaded a Missouri notice on Oct 2, notice dated Sept 24.

Ridgeback Landscaping (CP-2758) is on Plus with multi-state TaxDesk. A crew lead moved from Kansas to Missouri in August, but the address wasn't updated until October, so about 2 months of wages were withheld for Kansas instead of Missouri. Missouri sent a notice dated Sept 24, and it was uploaded Oct 2, which is within the 15-day window. Because the late update came from the customer, the Accuracy Promise probably doesn't cover the penalty unless the tax team finds a Cobalt error. Next step: Marcus Bell's team replies within 3 business days and corrects the state filings; the employee may need a W-2c ($25) after year-end.
Customer didn't return the old clock. What's the policy?

The old unit has to be returned with the prepaid label within 14 days of the replacement being delivered. Otherwise the full device price is billed: $249 for a CT-300, $399 for a CT-500. If tracking (Settings > Devices > [device] > Return Status) shows it was sent within 14 days, Tomasz Kowal's team can reverse the charge.
My employee had a baby 5 weeks ago and just now wants to add her to their health plan. BenefitsBridge won't let me. Can you override?

Congratulations to your employee! BenefitsBridge only accepts qualifying life event changes within 30 days of the event, so the Life Events screen locks after day 30. Some carriers make exceptions for a birth, so please send the request with the birth date to Elena Ruiz's BenefitsBridge team at cobaltcare@example.com and we will contact the carrier for you. Otherwise the baby can be added in the next open enrollment (BenefitsBridge > Plan Year). Carrier updates take up to 10 business days once they are approved.
We're opening a 2nd location. How much are the clocks?

Congratulations on the new location! The Cobalt Time clocks are the CT-300 (badge + PIN, $249) and the CT-500 (fingerprint, $399). Both sync punches every 15 minutes and include a 1-year warranty. Order them in Settings > Devices > Order Device; they ship 2-day from our Lincoln, Nebraska fulfillment center. Add the new site in Settings > Locations first so the clock picks up the right time zone.
We got a garnishment order from the county for one of our cooks (child support). Never done this before, where does it go in Cobalt?

No problem, we will walk you through it. Open Cobalt Run > People > [the cook's profile] > Deductions > Garnishments, choose Child Support, and upload the order with the withholding amount and agency details. To apply it on your next payroll, the order needs to be uploaded at least 3 business days before that pay date. On Starter and Plus you send the payment to the agency yourself using Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance; on Premier Cobalt remits it for you.
Two people got paid twice because they were in both the weekly and biweekly pay group. How did this happen

Sorry about this, here's what happened and how to fix it. When someone is in two pay groups, both runs pay them. Check Settings > Pay Groups > Members and leave each person in only one group. Moves made before a run's cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date) apply to that run. For the duplicates, request reversals in Cobalt Run > Payments > Reversals within 5 business days of the pay date; recovery depends on each employee's bank.
Micro deposits never showed up in our new bank account. It's been 4 days.

Sorry for the wait, we'll get this sorted out. The 2 micro-deposits (each under $1) normally arrive in 2-3 business days, so weekends don't count; if 3 business days have passed, please check that the routing and account numbers in Settings > Company Bank are correct. If they're correct, reply with the last 4 digits and we'll resend the deposits. Your payroll still debits the old verified account until the new one is confirmed, so keep it funded through the cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before your next pay date).
i approved payroll and then got a call that one employee quit last week and shouldnt be paid. its past the cutoff. pay date is tomorrow

Thanks for telling us right away, there may still be time. Once the regular cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date) has passed, the run can't be edited, but Payroll Ops can sometimes stop a single deposit before it is released. Please call 555-0142 now; this is a P1 and we answer within 1 hour. If it can't be stopped, request a reversal in Cobalt Run > Payments > Reversals within 5 business days of the pay date.
Child support order says to withhold $310 per pay period but the employee only makes about $600 net some weeks. Is there a cap? Cobalt is taking the full amount.

Good question, and you're right to check before payday. Child support is subject to a federal cap based on disposable earnings (usually 50-65% depending on the order), and Cobalt applies it automatically when Cap Method is set to Federal/State Limit. Please open Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Deductions > Garnishments and check that setting on this order. Any change needs to be saved before the cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date) to affect that run.
Dear support, I was charged full price for a clock we returned. We sent it back within a week.

Thank you for letting us know, and I'm sorry about the charge. Returns sent with the prepaid label within 14 days should not be billed. Open Settings > Devices > [device] > Return Status to see the tracking; if it shows delivered or in transit within the 14 days, reply here and Tomasz Kowal's hardware team will reverse the charge, usually within 3 business days.
Hi there - Ridgeback Landscaping here. One of our crew leads moved from Kansas to Missouri last month. Do I need to do anything in TaxDesk? We're on Plus.

Thanks for flagging it early, this is easy to handle. On Plus, TaxDesk files in multiple states, so open Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Tax Setup and update the home address and work state with the date of the move. TaxDesk will start Missouri withholding on the next run and will register the account if you don't have one yet. Make the change before the next cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date) so the right state is withheld. If wages since the move were taxed to Kansas, reply here and Marcus Bell's tax team will correct the filings.
New hire started Monday but I added her to Cobalt after I approved payroll. Will she be paid Friday?

She can be paid Friday. Since the regular run was already approved, she won't be in it, but you can pay her separately with Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle. Approve it by 4:00 PM CT Thursday (one business day before Friday) for no fee. Check that her Pay Method and Tax Setup are complete in People > [employee] first, or the run will flag her as incomplete.
Clock says 7:05 but its actually 8:05 here, we're in Eastern. Are punches recorded wrong?

Don't worry, the punches themselves are fine: the clock records them in UTC and Cobalt Time shows them in the location's time zone. The display shows Central because that location is set to Central. Change it in Settings > Devices > [clock] > Location Time Zone, and the CT-300/CT-500 updates on its next sync (every 15 minutes). Please check a few timecards in Cobalt Time > Timecards > Approve before the cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date).
Employee says she can't find her pay stubs anywhere. Where do employees log in?

Thanks for checking. Employees use the MyCobalt employee portal; her pay stubs and tax forms are under MyCobalt > Documents. If she never got an invite, open Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Employee Access and click Resend Invite. The invite link is valid for 7 days. Her pay is not affected, so she will be paid as normal on the next pay date.
I had to let an employee go today and our state requires the final paycheck within 72 hrs. Our regular payday is in 2 weeks. Help

We can get the final paycheck out in time. Open Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle, select the employee, choose Final Paycheck, and enter the last hours plus any payout your policy requires. A standard off-cycle approved by 4:00 PM CT one business day before its pay date has no fee. If you need the money in their account today, approve it as Express Off-Cycle before 10:00 AM CT ($45). After it is paid, mark them terminated in People > [employee] > Employment.
Who do I send a tax notice question to?

Tax notices go to the TaxDesk & year-end team led by Marcus Bell. Ask the customer to upload the notice in TaxDesk > Notices; the team responds within 3 business days. Remind them about the 15-day window for the Cobalt Accuracy Promise.
When is W-2c free vs paid?

Corrections made before Cobalt files W-2s on January 26 are free, because they're just edits. After filing, each W-2c is $25 and Cobalt files it within 5 business days; the employee copy is posted to MyCobalt > Documents. Simply re-downloading an existing W-2 is always free. The screen is TaxDesk > Year-End > W-2 Corrections; Marcus Bell's team owns year-end.

why am I being charged $25 for fixing a W-2? It was a typo in the address

What happens after a second NSF on the funding account?

A second funding return within 12 months puts the account on wire prefunding for 90 days. The customer wires the payroll total before each run is released instead of Cobalt debiting their account. After 90 clean days, normal debits resume. Escalate questions to Priya Natarajan's Payroll Ops team.
Can I cancel an off-cycle run I set up by mistake? Hasn't paid out yet

Yes. If its approval deadline (4:00 PM CT one business day before its pay date, or 10:00 AM CT for an Express run) hasn't passed, open Cobalt Run > Payroll > Run Off-Cycle, select the run and click Unapprove, then Delete. Nothing will be debited or paid. If you're too close to the deadline, call 555-0142 and Payroll Ops will help.
The insurance carrier says our new hire isn't enrolled but BenefitsBridge shows her as active since the 1st.

Thanks for checking, this usually just means the carrier hasn't processed it yet. BenefitsBridge sends enrollments to the carrier through a feed, and carriers can take up to 10 business days to update their system. You can see the date we sent it in BenefitsBridge > Enrollments > [employee] > Carrier Feed. If it's been more than 10 business days, reply here and Elena Ruiz's team will contact the carrier. Her payroll deduction is already in sync, so you don't need to change anything in Cobalt Run.
